items.description: World Bank-produced Google map on doing business in 175 countries. Countries are color-coded for ease of doing business there: easy, moderate, and difficult, in green, yellow and red respectively.

Pub Crawl uses the foursquare venues API to provide a way for you to plan a pub crawl in a neighbourhood and see the blokes who will likely be your drinking buddies there. Photos of mayors represent the venues (pubs and/or bars) and are ordered with the closest venues first. Click a photo to drilldown to the foursquare venue page and start your crawl!
Tallest skyscrapers in the world measured to the architectural top.
Test your knowledge of where countries are located with this interactive map quiz.
MapSkip allows you to share stories and photos about the places that are important in your life.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.
Unlock knowledge of the local market and gain an edge when buying or selling real estate. Answers are provided by local real estate agents eager to represent you in a transaction.
Find a roommate using Google Maps. Roommates enter the location of where they would be willing to live, and then you can search based on this.
The 99designs Tasks Slack Bot is a full featured graphic design assistant application in Slack.
Enter a zip code when you do a Jobster job search and see the locations plotted on a Google Map.

Toronto apartment rental search engine which mashes Google maps with apartment reviews, rental listings via Craigslist and property managers, subway stops and grocery stores. Renters can search by Toronto neighbourhood, intersection and subway station.
